entrypoints.description: A plate edited by its beats, on Ref2VA under the chosen edit LoRA, its trigger opening each beat. With no picture in a beat, the plate's own first frame is the picture.
entrypoints.name: edit

character_swap.description: Replace the main guide subject with the character in a reference image while following the guide performance

head_swap.description: Experimental reference-image head replacement over an aligned source video

motion_transfer.description: The character in the reference performs the guide video's motion

style_transfer.description: Transfer a visual style from an image or text description onto a video

vfx_edit.description: General prompt-directed VFX editing with an aligned source video

entrypoints.description: A segment on FL2VA: its text and its first and/or last keyframe, or text alone.
entrypoints.name: fl2va_segment

entrypoints.description: One continuous shot of any length, with sound (README.md): a summary, then what happens, beat by beat, each text with the references it mentions; an optional first and last frame; and Pick up from here, which goes on from a take at a frame. Returns the video and its latents, which a pickup of it resumes and an upscale starts from.
entrypoints.name: generate

entrypoints.description: A segment on Ref2VA: its references, the context it carries in, and its successor's.
entrypoints.name: ref2va_segment

entrypoints.description: Regenerate-2K over a whole shot: its 768p latent upscaled, refined at `resolution` in overlapping windows where the card needs them, and decoded with its soundtrack.
entrypoints.name: regenerate_shot

entrypoints.description: A take at 1080p, 1440p or 2160p, its sound kept (UPSCALE.md): its 768p latents upscaled and refined by H3 under the Regenerate LoRA, from the text they carry, else its frames from its description. A video already that big comes back as it is.
entrypoints.name: upscale
